name: scholarly-agent-suite
description: Modular cross-disciplinary scholarly research, writing, corpus, routing, and publication intelligence suite.

interface.shortDescription: Modular academic research, writing, corpus, routing, and publication intelligence suite
interface.longDescription: A modular cross-disciplinary academic AI agent suite for research execution, scholarly corpus construction, academic writing, author voice calibration, and evidence-backed publication strategy. Integrates five independent Skills -- scholarly-agent, adaptive-model-router, scholarly-corpus-builder, scholarly-voice-engine, and journal-fit-engine -- without collapsing them into one monolithic Skill.
defaultPrompt: Use $scholarly-agent to coordinate the smallest necessary set of scholarly specialist skills.
Help me turn this research idea into a manuscript and find a journal.
Improve this manuscript and tell me where to submit it.
